Subject: Post-demo: SOC2 & HIPAA scoping — SIG/CAIQ selection + MAP

Hi Sophie / Mateo —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. Per our call, I'm sending a short recap and a few clarifying questions that will help us pick the right questionnaire path (SIG vs CAIQ vs a brief custom form) and scope the evidence collection. I've attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP_Redwood-Healthlytics_v1.pdf) and a one-page SOC 2 readiness summary from our compliance team.

Quick recap / context:
- You confirmed Healthlytics will send PHI to the model pipeline (some ingestion + inference), so HIPAA controls and a BAA are required.
- Your security team prefers a standard SIG or CAIQ intake for vendor assessments but is open to a short custom checklist if it speeds things up.
- Timeline target: procurement + legal signoff in Q4 2026.

Clarifying questions for your security/privacy folks (helps us prefill and avoid back-and-forth):
1) Evidence owners — who on your side will own the intake (name + email)?
2) Data residency — do you require data to be restricted to a particular region (we can pin to us-east or dedicated VPC)?
3) KMS/HSM — will you require customer-managed keys or is a provider-managed KMS acceptable?
4) Encryption/in-transit — any specific cipher or FIPS requirements we should call out?
5) Preferred questionnaire — SIG (preferred for depth), CAIQ (faster), or your custom intake sheet? If you share the intake now we can prefill answers.

Proposed next steps:
- If you want SIG: we can prefill the CAIQ fields that overlap and send the SIG starter file within 48 hours.
- If you need a BAA before questionnaires: we can share our standard BAA and a draft SOW for private hosting.
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff with engineering/compliance to assign owners (I included a couple of suggested slots in the MAP).

Attachments: MAP_Redwood-Healthlytics_v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-readiness-summary.pdf

Thanks — I can chase anything your team drops into the intake spreadsheet.

Marissa

Hi Sophie / team — adding a few technical details you can drop into the intake sheet. Happy to expand if your security team prefers a short writeup.

Encryption and key mgmt (short paragraph for intake):
Redwood encrypts customer data at rest using AES-256. For hosted workloads we offer provider-managed KMS with keys stored in a cloud provider KMS; for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) we support customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) backed by either a cloud KMS or HSM. All network connections use TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers. We can provide configuration guidance for FIPS requirements if needed.

SOC 2 status: we are currently operating under SOC 2 Type II readiness controls; an external audit is scheduled for Oct 2026 with a target report availability in Q4 2026. We will provide the SOC 2 readiness summary (attached) and share the final report as soon as available.

Data residency and hosting options: we can pin serving to us-east and offer a dedicated GPU pool for predictable isolation under Redwood Dedicated. If you prefer an isolated VPC/private deployment, we'll scope that in the MAP and provide a draft BAA.

Links that might help: https://redwood-inference.example.com/compliance/soc2-summary (internal summary), https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxxEXAMPLE/redwood-healthlytics-maps (MAP + evidence checklist).

Ben
